subject: general
question: What does GAGAN, a satellite based navigation system, stand for?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GPS Aided Geo Augmented Navigation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GAGAN** stands for **GPS Aided Geo Augmented Navigation**.
 
• It is a satellite-based augmentation system (SBAS) developed by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) and the Airports Authority of India (AAI).
 
• The primary objective of GAGAN is to provide accurate and reliable navigation services over the Indian airspace, which is crucial for civil aviation.
 
• GAGAN improves the accuracy, integrity, and availability of GPS signals to meet the stringent requirements for civil aviation and other applications.
 
• It is the first SBAS system in the world to serve the equatorial region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **GAGAN** is interoperable with other international SBAS systems such as the US Wide Area Augmentation System (WAAS), European Geostationary Navigation Overlay Service (EGNOS), and Japan's Multi-functional Satellite Augmentation System (MSAS).
 
• The system enhances the accuracy of GPS to within 1.5 meters, compared to the 20-meter accuracy provided by unaugmented GPS.
 
• GAGAN is also intended to support a range of other applications including surveying, marine navigation, and disaster management.
 
• The system covers the entire Indian Flight Information Region (FIR) and extends beyond into neighboring regions.
